result.brief: Soundwich 将冻结的联合音视频流匹配模型改造为可生成多条同步、可独立编辑音频轨（语音、音乐、音效、环境声）的免训练框架，通过共享场景表征与跨模态路由保持音画一致与源级分离。
result.reason: Training-free framework turning a frozen joint audio-video flow-matching model into multi-stem, synchronized, editable audio generation coupled to shared video; directly targets joint audio-video generation and control.
